test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Wet blanket

options.text: One who spoils other people’s fun

solution:
The correct answer is **One who spoils the other's fun**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** meaning of the given idiom '**Wet blanket**' is '**One who spoils other people’s fun**'.
 
• **Wet blanket**: *one that quenches or dampens enthusiasm or pleasure.*
 
 
• **E.g.** *Nobody asked him to join the group because he's such a **wet blanket*****.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at some similar idioms.
 
 
• **Killjoy**- My husband can be a real **killjoy **sometimes, always shooting down the fun things I suggest for our family vacations.
 
• **To be a pain in the neck**- A lazy employee is a pain in the neck for the boss
 
• **To drive someone up the wall**- Jane__: *Does Mark help you with the housework?*

 __Sarah__: *No, never. He drives me up the wall.*
